objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-credentials-from-password-stores-chrome-login-data-access
objects.description: The following analytic identifies non-Chrome processes accessing the Chrome user data file "login data." This file is an SQLite database containing sensitive information, including saved passwords. The detection leverages Windows Security Event logs, specifically event code 4663, to monitor access attempts.
